cases.name: High-Converting Product Landing Page with Hero, Features & Interactive CTA
cases.prompt: Create a modern, high-converting product landing page for a developer AI tool. Include a striking hero section, feature highlight cards with icons, interactive pricing tier toggle (monthly/annual), testimonials carousel, FAQ accordion, and lead capture newsletter form with email validation.

requiredElements.name: hero_headline
requiredElements.description: Compelling H1 title with subheading and primary CTA button

requiredElements.name: pricing_toggle_control
requiredElements.description: Toggle switch between monthly and annual pricing

requiredElements.name: faq_accordion_items
requiredElements.description: Interactive expandable/collapsible questions and answers

requiredElements.name: email_input_field
requiredElements.description: Input element with email validation feedback

cases.name: Interactive Analytics Dashboard with Search, Charts & CSV Export
cases.prompt: Build an interactive analytics dashboard featuring real-time data filtering, search across data rows, interactive charts (line/bar/pie), and CSV data export functionality with loading and error states.

requiredElements.name: search_input
requiredElements.description: Text input or search field filtering displayed rows

requiredElements.name: data_table_or_grid
requiredElements.description: Table or grid displaying filtered records

requiredElements.name: chart_component
requiredElements.description: Visual chart (SVG, canvas, or chart library) displaying metrics

requiredElements.name: csv_export_button
requiredElements.description: Button triggering CSV export or file download

cases.name: E-Commerce Catalog with Cart Drawer, Promo Code & Validated Checkout
cases.prompt: Build an e-commerce catalog with category filtering, price range slider, product detail modal, add-to-cart with quantity adjustment, persistent cart state, discount promo code calculation, and checkout form with validation.

requiredElements.name: catalog_grid
requiredElements.description: Products displayed with image, title, price, and add button

requiredElements.name: category_or_price_filter
requiredElements.description: Controls to filter products by category or price

requiredElements.name: cart_management
requiredElements.description: Cart view or drawer with quantity +/- and remove actions

requiredElements.name: promo_code_input
requiredElements.description: Input field to apply coupons or promo discounts

requiredElements.name: checkout_form
requiredElements.description: Form with name, email, and address inputs and validation

cases.name: Educational Quiz Application with Timer, Progress & High Scores
cases.prompt: Build an education quiz application with timed questions, category selection, instant feedback on answers, progress bar tracking, score review screen, and local persistence of high scores.

requiredElements.name: category_selector
requiredElements.description: Option to select quiz topics or difficulties

requiredElements.name: progress_indicator
requiredElements.description: Progress bar or counter showing current question vs total

requiredElements.name: answer_options
requiredElements.description: Selectable answer buttons or inputs

requiredElements.name: score_screen
requiredElements.description: Review screen summarizing final score and breakdown

requiredElements.name: persistence_call
requiredElements.description: localStorage or store saving past scores or user stats

cases.name: Full-Stack API-Backed CRUD with Express & React
cases.prompt: Build a full-stack task and note management application with an Express backend REST API (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE /api/items), persistent store, input validation, and a React frontend with optimistic UI updates and error boundary.

requiredElements.name: item_creation_form
requiredElements.description: Form sending POST request to create an item

requiredElements.name: item_list_view
requiredElements.description: List displaying items fetched from GET /api/items

requiredElements.name: item_delete_action
requiredElements.description: Button or action triggering DELETE /api/items/:id

requiredElements.name: item_update_action
requiredElements.description: Inline edit or modal sending PUT /api/items/:id

cases.name: Targeted Multi-Step Code Repair for Broken State & Syntax Errors
cases.prompt: Analyze a project workspace with an unhandled runtime exception in state updates and a missing API parameter. Identify the root causes, preserve existing architecture, apply minimal surgical diffs, and verify that the build succeeds without regressions.

requiredElements.name: corrected_state_handler
requiredElements.description: Immutable state updater fixing mutation bug

requiredElements.name: repaired_api_call
requiredElements.description: Fixed request payload with required parameters

requiredElements.name: verification_evidence
requiredElements.description: Test or build log proving the fix resolved the error
